services.value: Eurofins provides “analytical testing services” across markets and industries, including “Life Food and Feed Testing,” “Environment Testing,” “Agro Testing,” “Sensory and Consumer Research,” “Diagnostic Services & Products,” “In Vitro Diagnostics Solutions,” “Clinical Diagnostics,” and “Forensic Services.” The text also lists “Contract Development & Manufacturing Organisation (CDMO)” and other BioPharma-related services such as “Agroscience Services” and “Genomic Services.”
